infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fiix needs your location to verify Time In/Out and to guide you to client locations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Fiix needs to track your location in the background while you're clocked in, so dispatch can see technician positions and reach you if GPS drops.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fiix needs camera access to attach photos to maintenance reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fiix needs photo library access to attach existing photos to maintenance reports.
